rules.statement: When there is a conflict between the recitals and the operative part of a conveyance, the terms of the operative part should decide the question.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is a well settled principle of construction of an instrument that the recitals are subordinate to the operative part, and consequently when the operative part is clear it is treated as expressing the intention of the parties and it prevails over any suggestion of a contrary intention afforded by the recitals."
